points.point: biggest file size allowed (on Starter plan)
points.sentence: The largest file size you can upload to Blotato in a single request: 400 MB on Starter, 1 GB on Creator and Agency.

points.point: why 650 MB video won't upload (too large; what to do)
points.sentence: If your file is too large, compress or trim it, or upgrade your plan.
